item: CRUD gap G7, module 2 of 3: participant label correction as an append-only overlay
spec: docs/revamp/specs/crud-standard.md; docs/revamp/crud/summary.md G7; Conductor approval of 5 Nov (overlay design, order lifecycle, participant label, recipient response)
changed: packages/db/customer-participant-label-migrations/0001_participant_label.sql: programme_registration_label_revision and programme_registration_label_command (append-only, reject_rewrite, version order guard, RLS, no runtime grants); view customer_private.programme_registration_current (label_version is 0 until a correction); customer.programme_registration_label(command,registration,expected,label); audit through domain_event/audit_event/outbox; readers of the label read the view, each behind a sha256 guard of the definition it replaces (needs the programme lifecycle installed first).

packages/db/src/customer-participant-label-migrate.ts (hash-recorded, refuses to run without the programme lifecycle, never installs it); scripts/install-customer-modules.ts and .github/workflows/install-customer-modules.yml: new field_modules_action choice participant_labels; tests/workflow-inputs.test.mjs extended.

packages/auth/src/customer-participants.ts: label action derives the scope from the registration (the caller names only the registration, the version they saw and the new label); apps/web/app/api/customer-programme-participants/route.ts: plain refusals for a stale label and no change.

apps/web/app/account/delegations/participant-label.tsx, participant-account.tsx, programme-participants.tsx, participant-client.ts: Edit My Label for the participant, Edit Label for an owner or admin; the controls appear only when the list carries a label version, so nothing shows before the owner installs the module.

Standard from the programme lifecycle review applied: Save always sends the version the form opened at; a stale answer or a newer label after any reload keeps the typed text and shows Keep Mine or Use Theirs; the draft survives the list reload (in memory only, dropped when the page is hidden or left); 429 uses the shared words; the same command is repeated after a lost answer; Check Again when the latest label could not be loaded.

Guardian review of ea2044b: programme_projection_rows is replaced behind a prosrc hash guard so the roster and agenda selector show the current label (the installer installs the projections module first); the audit event and outbox carry ids, the new version and who changed it, never the label text (test: no label text in domain_event or outbox); own_programme_registrations returns labelChangedBy and the participant sees 'Label changed by the organiser' when the organiser made the latest correction; a successful save is announced in a status region; the label check counts characters and refuses every control character as the database does.

Codex review of 1f74a2a: a label save refused with 401 or 403 now drops the typed-label drafts and takes the same deny path as every other participant action (the private roster and results are cleared); two UI tests, red on the previous editor.
preserved: customer_private.programme_registration is never rewritten and consent (consented_at) is untouched by a label correction; the original label is the fallback when no revision exists.
A participant can correct only their own label; an owner or admin can correct any label in their workspace; command id idempotency; a stale version is refused with 409 and a plain message.

Audit event keeps old and new values. Nothing is installed in production; no switch, provider, payment, outreach or AI change. Archive rules from module 1 are unchanged (organiser edits to existing registrations stay open).

verification.integration: tests/integration/customer-participant-labels.test.ts 12 passed and customer-programme-lifecycle.test.ts 18 passed (adds: projections show the current label, no label text in the event log or outbox, labelChangedBy, correcting a label while the programme is archived and after restoring it)
verification.operator: tests/operator/v3-participant-label-ui.spec.ts 12 passed (6 tests red on the previous editor: stale choice, Use Theirs, reload, rate limit, and two refused saves) and v3-customer-participants-ui.spec.ts 15 passed

openRisks: Needs the owner's install run with field_modules_action=participant_labels after the programme lifecycle is installed; until then the screen is unchanged.
The replaced readers are guarded by the hash of their definition; the install job fails closed if production differs.
Recipient response revision is module 3, a separate PR.
A label draft is cleared when the browser tab is hidden (the page's existing privacy behaviour for every draft).
